newsitem.title: USA: Dal-Tile names Jacques Sardas President/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Dal-Tile names Jacques Sardas President/CEO.

text.p: Dal-Tile International said Monday it named Jacques Sardas as its president and chief executive officer, effective July 1.
Sardas succeeds Howard Bull, Dal-Tile's chief executive since April, 1994, who said he will resign to spend more time with his family.
Sardas spent 34 years as an executive at Goodyear Tire. Most recently, he was chairman and chief executive of Sudbury Inc.
Dal-Tile makes, distributes and markets ceramic tile throughout the world.
